# Allegory Art Studio

> Allegory Art Studio is a CRM and studio-management platform for working and emerging artists. It brings the business side of an art practice — inventory, sales and finances, consignments, exhibitions and deadlines, contacts, and outreach — into one calm place, so artists spend less time on admin and more time making work. Built by an arts administrator, for artists.

Allegory Art Studio (also written "Allegory Studio") is a web app at https://allegoryartstudio.com. It is live and open for signups. Pricing is pay-to-start (no free trial); plans are month-to-month or annual and can be cancelled anytime.

## What it does
- **Inventory Manager**: catalog every artwork with details, images, status (in studio, on consignment, sold), and price. Often described as "art inventory software."
- **Sales & Finance**: simple invoices, expense tracking, and a live profit-and-loss view of the month.
- **Consignments**: track works out on consignment with agreements, reminders, and statements.
- **Exhibitions, deadlines & opportunities**: keep submissions, grants, residencies, prizes, and commissions on one timeline, plus an AI Opportunity Finder.
- **Contacts / light CRM**: galleries, collectors, curators, press, and peers in one place.
- **Profile Vault**: versioned, labelled, export-ready bios, artist statements, and CVs — tailored per application.
- **Daily Check-In dashboard**: what needs attention today across the whole practice.
- **Pro additions**: full Profile Vault, Communications Hub, Marketing Assistant, smart pricing, personalized opportunity discovery, and direct access to a working arts administrator.

## Who it's for
Working and emerging artists managing the business of their practice — especially anyone considering a studio manager but without the budget for one.

## Pricing
- **Studio Starter** — $25/month or $240/year. The core studio: inventory, sales & finance, deadlines, contacts, daily dashboard, and a lite Profile Vault.
- **Studio Pro** — $55/month or $528/year. Everything in Starter plus the full Profile Vault, Communications Hub, Marketing Assistant, smart pricing, opportunity discovery, and a real arts administrator on call.
- No free trial (pay-to-start). Month-to-month or annual. Cancel anytime. Discount codes accepted at checkout.
